The system shall display the sign up form with the fields above and a "Sign up" button.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
* The system shall display the sign up form with the fields above and a "Sign up" button.
* Full name must be 2 to 60 characters; letters, spaces, hyphens and apostrophes.
* Email must be valid email format; maximum 254 characters; unique, case-insensitive.
* Password must be 8 to 64 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit and one symbol.
* Confirm password must match the password.
* Terms and privacy checkbox must be ticked to submit.
* The system shall validate each field on blur and again on submit, showing the error under the field.
* The system shall keep the "Sign up" button disabled until all required fields are valid.
* The system shall let the user show or hide the password and confirm password values.
* The system shall show a password strength indicator while the user types.
* The page shall include a "Already have an account? Log in" link to the login page.

On submit, the system shall check that the email is not already registered and reject the request with a clear message if it is.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
* The system shall check that the email is not already registered and reject the request with a clear message if it is.
* The system shall store the password only as a salted hash and never return it in any response.
* The system shall create the account in an unverified state and send a verification email containing a link valid for 24 hours.

When the user opens a valid verification link, the system shall mark the account verified and redirect to the login page with a success message.

h3. Acceptance Criteria
* The system shall show a confirmation screen telling the user to check their email, with a "Resend email" action limited to once every 60 seconds.
* When the user opens a valid verification link, the system shall mark the account verified and redirect to the login page with a success message.
* If the verification link is expired or invalid, the system shall explain this and offer to send a new link.
